messages:
Anya D: Quick kickoff — PLG activation experiment: free credits + prompt templates + onboarding nudges. Goal: +15% 7-day DAU from new signups. Start Monday. Who can own landing + benchmark blog + webinar + routing?
Mike P: I can own the landing and the benchmark narrative. Plan to show cost/latency vs open models and a short dev story.
Sara L: I'll run onboarding flows + email nudge sequence. Thinking: 3 free credits immediately, 1 follow-up nudge at 24h, then a tips email at 72h. Short SMS test too?
Ben K: I'll wire analytics. Need event naming conventions and expected UTM params. Also want to measure token usage per activation.
Nina O: I can set up lead routing—SFDC mapping and a webhook for demo requests. Where do we put 'activation_variant' tag?
Anya D: Put activation_variant=credit-3|credit-5|no-credit in utm_content. Benchmarks: Mike, show 3 tables: latency, unit cost, dev time to integrate.
Mike P: Outline: 1) TL;DR stats, 2) Benchmarks (p95 latency, cost/token), 3) Quickstart + prompt templates, 4) Customer story + CTA to webinar.
Sara L: Draft email sequence (short):
- Day0: Welcome + 3 credits + quickstart link
- Day1: Nudge w/ prompt templates + use case examples
- Day3: Ask for feedback + invite to webinar
Example copy: "Use these 3 starter prompts to see results in minutes → <link>"
Sara L: Prompt template snippet:
```json
{\"name\":\"bug-summary\",\"prompt\":\"Summarize this bug in one sentence for a PM:\\n{issue_text}\",\"examples\":[]}
```
Ben K: Analytics snippet for events:
```js
track('plg_activate', {variant:'credit-3', step:'onboard_start', tokens_used:0})
```
Nina O: SFDC mapping curl (example):
```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.example.com/lead -d '{\"email\":\"{email}\",\"source\":\"PLG\",\"activation_variant\":\"credit-3\"}'
```
Anya D: Webinar planning — 30-min product demo + AMA. Proposed date: Thu 2pm PT. Deploy-bot, can you create the calendar?
deploy-bot: Event created: "PLG Kickstart — 30m demo" Thu 14:00 PT — Zoom link set. Attendees: @marketing, @growth
Mike P: I will draft the landing copy + hero stat by EOD Friday. Ben, what do you need to add instrumentation?
Ben K: Please add data-layer push on signup:
```js
dataLayer.push({event:'signup', activation_variant:'{{utm_content}}'})
```
Sara L: I'll write email copy and the 1-click in-app nudge. Will sync with Nina on SFDC fields.
Anya D: Ownership:
- Landing + benchmark: Mike
- Onboarding + emails + in-app nudge: Sara
- Analytics: Ben
- Lead routing + SFDC: Nina
- Webinar ops: Anya
Cool. Next sync Thu morning for launch checklist. :rocket:
